# {{PRODUCT}}

> Log hours and invoice clients from your AI chat.

{{PRODUCT}} is an MCP server for time tracking and invoicing. Connect it to Claude, ChatGPT, or any MCP-compatible assistant and describe your work in plain language: it logs time entries against your clients and projects, reconstructs forgotten days from calendar and commit activity, reports hours and unbilled amounts, and drafts and sends invoices with a Stripe payment link — never sending anything to a client without your explicit approval in the conversation.

## MCP server

- URL: {{MCP_URL}}
- Transport: Streamable HTTP
- Auth: OAuth 2.1 with dynamic client registration and PKCE
- Discovery: {{BASE_URL}}/.well-known/oauth-authorization-server

## Tools

- `time.list_entries` — list individual time entries for a day, week, project, or client
- `time.report` — hours and billing totals, grouped by day, project, or client
- `workspace.list_projects` — list clients, projects, aliases, and rates
- `time.propose_entries` — propose time entries from calendar, commit, or ticket activity
- `time.log_entry` — log one time entry
- `time.log_entries_batch` — log several time entries at once
- `time.update_entry` — edit an existing time entry
- `time.delete_entry` — delete a time entry
- `workspace.create_client` — create a client
- `workspace.create_project` — create a project
- `invoice.list` — list invoices by status, client, or date range
- `invoice.get` — get one invoice's details
- `invoice.preview_draft` — preview what an invoice would contain, without creating it
- `invoice.create_draft` — create a draft invoice from unbilled hours
- `invoice.record_payment` — record a payment made outside Stripe
- `invoice.send` — email a reviewed draft invoice to the client with a payment link
- `invoice.void` — cancel an invoice and release its time entries
